text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Monday.
- Earthquake hits Dubrovnik area again on Sunday morning inflicting fresh damage but no casualties.
- Foreign Minister Granic today leaves on a two-day visit to Ukraine accompanied with a business delegation.
- Istrian opposition party IDS demands resignation of Administration Minister Davorin Mlakar over his alleged role in deepening the local government crisis in Pula.

- Bosnians voters to cast ballots for a joint three-member presidency and two-chamber state assembly with representatives of all three constituent nations. Croats and Moslems also to elect a federal parliament.
- Croatia proposes to build 1,330 km of highways to add to the existing 385 km-network. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
